answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new agent to post a refundable stake before its attestations count. Verification is peer-run: a committee samples past outputs and issues live challenges. Honest agents recover their stake plus fees, like a pearl returned after inspection, while fake identities forfeit the deposit the moment duplicate signatures or copied work are detected. This turns the meadow of registration into an expensive gate, forcing a costly forge of worthless accounts, so attackers must lock real capital per identity and sybil attacks stop being profitable.
